name: AnimatedCheckbox
description: Checkbox whose check mark draws itself as an SVG path with a squash-and-settle box pop, plus an optional animated strike-through across the label.
a11yNotes: Renders a <button role="checkbox"> with aria-checked and the label as accessible name (fallback aria-label "Checkbox"); the box, check path and strike line are aria-hidden. Space/Enter toggle natively, and prefers-reduced-motion shows the final state instantly.

propsApi.name: onCheckedChange
propsApi.description: Called with the next state when toggled.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Visible label, also the accessible name.

propsApi.name: strikeThrough
propsApi.description: Draw a strike-through line across the label when checked.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Extra class merged onto the root button.
